title: Graphic Design — Practical Assessment
description: Verdant House campaign flyer — social media promotional flyer, 1080 x 1440 pixels, portrait.
instructions:
CLIENT DESIGN BRIEF

Project: Campaign flyer
Client: VERDANT HOUSE
Industry: Lifestyle & Indoor Plants
Design Format: Social Media Promotional Flyer
Dimensions: 1080 x 1440 pixels
Orientation: Portrait

1. ABOUT THE BRAND

Verdant House is a contemporary lifestyle brand dedicated to bringing nature closer to people through indoor plants, decorative plant pots, and thoughtfully curated greenery for homes and workspaces.

The brand believes that a beautiful environment contributes to a better quality of life. Its mission is to make indoor gardening simple, accessible, and aesthetically appealing.

Verdant House wants to connect with young professionals, homeowners, interior design enthusiasts, and anyone interested in creating beautiful living spaces.

2. THE PROJECT

Verdant House is preparing to launch a new collection of indoor plants and decorative planters called THE GREEN LIVING COLLECTION.

The client wants a promotional social media design to announce the collection and generate excitement among potential customers.

Your task is to develop a creative promotional flyer that communicates the brand's personality, introduces the new collection, and encourages people to explore the products.

3. DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

Your design must include the following:

A. Brand Logo
- Create an original logo for VERDANT HOUSE.
- The logo should communicate nature, elegance, freshness, and modern living.
- You are free to explore typography-based logos, symbols, or a combination of both.
- The logo must be incorporated into the final design.

B. Visual Direction
- Source appropriate visual assets that communicate indoor gardening, beautiful interiors, and plant aesthetics.
- You may use images of indoor plants, decorative pots, beautifully styled interiors, or people interacting with plants.
- Your choice of images should complement the overall design concept.

C. Background & Composition
- Develop an interesting background that complements the brand.
- You may explore textures, patterns, abstract shapes, decorative elements, or other creative treatments.
- Pay attention to depth, balance, contrast, and the positioning of visual elements.

D. Typography
- Establish a clear typographic hierarchy.
- The main headline should be visually dominant.
- Supporting information should be readable and properly arranged.
- Explore font combinations that complement the brand's identity.

4. REQUIRED DESIGN CONTENT

The following information must appear in your design:

Brand Name: VERDANT HOUSE

Main Headline:
BRING NATURE HOME.

Supporting Text:
Discover a refreshing collection of indoor plants and beautifully designed planters curated to transform your everyday spaces.

Campaign Title:
THE GREEN LIVING COLLECTION

Call to Action:
EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Website:
www.verdanthouse.com

5. CREATIVE DIRECTION

The client wants something that feels:
- Modern and sophisticated.
- Fresh, vibrant, and visually appealing.
- Minimal yet creatively expressive.
- Premium without feeling inaccessible.
- Strong enough to stand out on social media.

Suggested colour direction: Earthy greens, warm beige, cream, muted browns, and other nature-inspired colours.

You are not restricted to these colours. Feel free to explore a different palette if it strengthens your creative concept.

6. DELIVERABLES

Each student is expected to submit:
1. An original VERDANT HOUSE brand logo.
2. A completed promotional flyer measuring 1080 x 1440 pixels.
3. The final design in PNG or JPG format.
4. An editable source file of the design.

Because the editable source file and full-resolution artwork are often large, submit them as links (Google Drive, Dropbox or similar) rather than uploads. Set the sharing so the academy can view or download the files. Use the response box below to explain your concept, your logo idea, and the design decisions you made.

7. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS

- Do not use an existing company's logo.
- Do not copy an existing flyer or design concept.
- You are encouraged to research visual references and gather inspiration before designing.
- Ensure that all images and visual assets are properly integrated into the composition.
- Pay attention to alignment, spacing, contrast, hierarchy, and overall presentation.
- Every element in your design should contribute to the visual communication of the brand.

Your objective is to deliver a professional promotional design that looks like something a real brand would confidently publish on its social media platforms.

Good luck!
